* org-info-src.js
- References
- [[https://orgmode.org/manual/JavaScript-support.html][JavaScript Support]]
- [[https://orgmode.org/worg/code/org-info-js/][EMACS ORG-INFO.JS]] 

Allows the web page to be viewed similar to how they look in emacs for me.
  
- Possible GOTCHA.  I use html5 export and code is written for XHTML export.
  So far I don't see any issues.

- Downloaded as org-info-src.js from [[https://orgmode.org/worg/code/org-info-js/org-info-src.js][WORG Org-Mode site]] on 2025-03-04
